prose: Uncracked City is a Show HN detective game from a solo founder in which a model plays the detective and you question LLM suspects, one of whom lies. Each case is set in a real city with real public places, while the crime and characters are invented. The sample case is a Halloween 2025 mystery in Salem with four suspects. Only the author's intro and a case blurb were captured.
highlights: Detective game: question LLM suspects, one of whom lies
Cases are set in real cities with real public places; crimes and people are invented
Sample case: Salem, morning after Halloween, four suspects
basis: Thin cache (352 chars). Written from the author's intro text and case blurb only.
